secrets.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack live secret key — enables live payments + webhook verification. Without it, checkout runs in demo mode. Get it from the Paystack dashboard (Settings > API Keys).

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL — activates Supabase Auth + Edge Function calls. Without it, the app uses built-in local auth. Get it from the Supabase dashboard (Project Settings > API).

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon key — paired with the project URL. Get it from the Supabase dashboard (Project Settings > API).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (server-only) — used for admin calls and Edge Function invocation. Get it from the Supabase dashboard (Project Settings > API).
